questions.question: What is Tata?
questions.answer: Tata refers to the Tata Group, one of India's largest and oldest conglomerates, founded in 1868 by Jamsetji Tata. It is headquartered in Mumbai and operates across steel, automobiles, IT services, consumer goods, hospitality and aviation.
